problem_type: Settled attempts borrow live node narration
symptom: Regenerating a saved node makes its previous completed task row say generating.
direct_cause: buildTaskCenterView calls generationFeedback on the live node for settled queue entries.
class_root: Task attempt outcome and mutable node state are not separated at the projection boundary.
affected_population: Success, failure, cancellation histories while the same node generates again
internal_only_reason: Internal Electron event and generation lifecycle; no third-party contract or new dependency.
invariants: Settled attempts use their own recorded outcome/error; only active entries use live generation narration.
generality_proof: One task projection serves panel and summary; every settled outcome is resolved independently of the newer attempt.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve historical and live facts by attempt lifecycle.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses the same projection for summary, including recoverable counts.

recurrence.reason: Any node regeneration can reinterpret all prior attempts.
same_class_scan: Read TaskCenterPanel and TaskCenterButton calls to buildTaskCenterView.
Checked success/error/cancelled entries sharing one running node.

prevention.invariant: Only live queue groups consume mutable node feedback.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing settled error uses the recorded generic outcome, never newer live narration.
prevention.strategy: Use entry error/outcome for done rows; recoverability applies only to the latest node entry.

legacy_paths.rationale: Unconditional live-node narration for settled entries removed.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing Electron IPC and runtime; no package change.

residual_risks: Historical entries without recorded error can show only the generic outcome.

invariant_owner_layer.note: The task projection owns attempt identity.
